stage: Lighthouse operation project 1 phase 3: three local inspections, fixed salt film, cancellable standby-only cleaning and recheck, seven-day session journal; existing automatic navigation and geometry retained
author: babylon-demo project contributors
license: Original geometry/sky: project ISC; photographic maps: CC0-1.0, see textures/coastal/source.json
generation: Deterministic metre-based terrain, closed chipped/layered cliff, plinth, opaque folded grass and shrub leaves, buried rock clusters. Seed 41723. Photographic Seaside Rock (Dimitrios Savva, 2m) and Aerial Grass Rock (Rob Tuytel, 15m), Poly Haven CC0. Coast-arc/height UV, macro/strata colour, damp lower wall, shore rock blend. Neutral sun-free linear RGBE environment has no baked solar hotspot; dynamic analytic sky, ocean and a scoped sun/moon reuse the eight shared time nodes. 128-face HDR prefilter, per-material environment scale/tint, one cached 1024 local shadow. No AI-generated assets or photographic scenery walls. Ground PBR uses translation-only hex blending, identical geometry weights for albedo/normal/ARM; no tangent rotation. Coast columns share shading normals across patch boundaries, with hard vertical ledges. World-anchored near-dense/far-coarse ocean, three analytic displacement waves, filtered crossing ripple normals, linear Fresnel sky reflection and rough GGX sun/moon highlights from the same time/sky parameters, exterior-only marine haze. A generated 512x512 RGBA8 signed-distance/seabed field intersects the closed rock wall at mean sea level and controls water colour and animated broken foam. No additional image download or ocean reflection/refraction target.
supersedes: Forest Slope panorama and bark no longer ship or load in the current scene; historical originals and provenance remain in the repository and frozen eight-room-v1 baseline.
limitations: Low-frequency neutral IBL excludes local house/cliff reflections. Mean-sea-level shoreline/seabed do not track wave crests; no fluid physics. One local cached shadow zone, no full-route distant long shadows. Navigation uses a single rotating emissive face with view-dependent white flash; no volumetric beam, sea/house sweep, added light or shadow target, or calibrated maritime range. Inspection, deterministic solar/cover maintenance and explicit local duty saves are delivered; weather/random risk and the four deferred advanced player operation groups remain optional. Browser viewport simulation is not physical mobile/Safari acceptance.
materialProvenance: textures/coastal/source.json: fixed upstream URLs/authors/license, original PNG SHA256, processing parameters, delivered bytes/SHA256; upstream CC0 https://polyhaven.com/license

generatedOceanTexture.format: RGBA8 linear; RG=16-bit signed distance, B=approximate seabed depth
generatedOceanTexture.source: CoastalOcean.coastalShoreField / actual CoastalCliff wall rings 7-8 at -28 metres

lighthouse.earthworks: Shared CoastalSite road grade, 3.5m inner corridor blended to the terrain over 8m; the last 14m meets the level tower plaza. Rendered terrain triangles drive road placement.
lighthouse.materials: Original filtered world-scale plaster/timber/seamed-roof finishes and gravel/paving reusing the existing coastal rock color/normal/ARM maps; shared outdoor HDR. No new image/model downloads.
lighthouse.walking: Shared rendered terrain/road/ramp triangles and platform tops; 0.26m player radius, 0.1m swept horizontal steps, maximum 30-degree walkable ground, 0.18m step, solid tower/bench/large rocks and height-independent exterior walls/guardrails. One batched original timber guardrail encloses the finite exploration area. The entry path first clears the door jamb; the bench is offset from the walking centreline.
lighthouse.geometry: Tapered permanent 64-sector shaft with real closed door/window recesses, stone base, octagonal glass lantern/internal brass lens, batched gallery rail, low-pitch house roof/eaves/gables/window sills, slatted bench and arrow-shaped route signs. Fine door/mullion detail hides at 85m and returns within 65m; permanent shell, lantern, gallery silhouette and walking support remain.
lighthouse.shadows: One existing 1024 PCF render-once target with house/path/tower anchors and 6m selection hysteresis. Current sun/moon direction and position update together; source is 400 world units from the current anchor, depth range 5..800, fixed 250/280-unit local frustum. Near-house bias 0.00015/0.045, outdoor 0.001/0.25; weak moon shadows use 0.18 darkness. Static local architecture/rails/vegetation/rocks only; no new light or RTT, distant long shadows remain outside local coverage.

dayNight.postProcessing: Existing ACES/exposure 1.12, one linear-to-display image-processing pass
dayNight.environment: environment/coastal-daylight.hdr retains its URL but is now a neutral sun-free environment; generation, original replacement SHA256 and delivery SHA256 in textures/coastal/source.json
dayNight.manualApi: RoomScene.setTimeOfDay; immediate shared visual application, user lamp switches preserved
dayNight.windowLighting: Existing window proxies accept max(0, outwardNormal dot sourceDirection); back-facing openings retain indirect light only; material IBL tracks late imports and skips mirror RTTs/previews

lighthouseEquipment.author: babylon-demo project contributors
lighthouseEquipment.installation: Closed main-drive hatch within the existing protected optical core; overhead backup bracket and independent interlocked white-flash lens above the roof apex. Closed main battery cabinet and separate controller in the first-floor right-hand space. South-facing solar rack and separate ventilated generator room inside the existing plaza, keeping the original 5.5m walking ring, route, parking and boundary. Fixed light-sensor protective face on the east gallery glazing, clear of the walking ring.

generatedAtlas.method: Deterministic original 5x7 bitmap glyphs, eight 64px plaque rows; no canvas, font or image download

lighthouseEquipment.stateBoundary: Historical step-three simulation capability retained for optional future work; current player access is restricted by playerScope below. Actual scene-hour Wh model: main 2880Wh and backup 120Wh, each starts at 80%; main lamp 50W, control 5W, backup 5W; analytic 250W sunny solar envelope 06-18, dirty factor 0.2; solar fault/isolation blocks only solar. Diesel 200W split up to 10W independent backup charge, remainder main; fuel 4 of 12 units initially, reserve 8, one unit per scene hour, stopped refill 4 units over three active seconds. Main warning 25%, protection 10%, recovery 20% plus local meter check with healthy drive; main isolation and faults remain independent. No background/manual time catch-up. Actual 5-active-second charging verification measures main battery Wh under automatic time, with source isolation and separate generator start/output verification. Four independent drills, including an explicitly labelled 21:00 / 11% main-battery supply exercise (normal initial energy stays 80%), suspend/restore energy, fuel and logs with the original session. No extra geometry, materials, download, light, camera or render target. Original vertex colour generator state feedback and reused switch cue; no added continuous engine audio. Persistent storage remains later.
lighthouseEquipment.backupEmission: Original local GLSL white emission on the existing cylindrical lens, with real geometry/depth and clip planes; no extra light, image, camera or render target.

playerScope.active: Six player capability groups: automatic navigation, control readings, optic observation, cover cleaning, solar patrol/simple energy readings, session paper journal. Local instrument UI uses original CSS/SVG art, two gauges maximum, contextual actions and five journal rows per page. Center reticle ring follows accepted action/observation time and closes only on actual completion. Step four adds cover cleaning every three accepted duty days and solar cleaning every five, revision-aware reinspection, and one explicit local version-1 save/continue slot. New sessions start at noon with automatic time; continued sessions restore exact fractional time paused without offline catch-up. Invalid/future slots are retained until explicit clearing; writes and interrupted transactions cannot silently consume inventory.
playerScope.deferred: Manual backup/self-tests/isolation, module diagnostics/replacement/drills, diesel fuel/refill/drill, sensor overrides/drill are optional plans. Simulation logic retained for future work; no current UI or Room command path enables these groups. Automatic safety/energy model remains active; recovery-ready battery supports one local verification action.

lighthouseOperation.author: babylon-demo project contributors
lighthouseOperation.generatedGeometry: Existing static optic core, ring bands and nine glass rings separated into a rotating transform. Fixed frame/base/outer glass retained. Single forward emissive face and asymmetric housing remain inside the original 0.44m protected core; fixed test control remains on the south side of the base.
lighthouseOperation.emission: Original GLSL directional lobe: inner 6 degrees, outer 12 degrees, smooth forward white signal; per-render main or reflected eye, existing tone mapping/bloom/depth and clip planes. Source code contains complete reproduction parameters; no image asset. At distance, the existing face receives a minimum 3-pixel directional footprint in its vertex shader, with its actual depth/clip planes retained; close views retain real dimensions. This is an artistic visibility compensation, not calibrated photometry or navigation range. Phase 3 applies an artistic salt-film transmission multiplier (dirty 0.82, clean 1.0) to the existing directional emission; motor, schedule and power remain unchanged.
lighthouseOperation.records: Existing deterministic atlas retained. Physical clipboard now opens the dynamic Chinese session journal; three daily checks, timestamped observations, revision-bound surface evidence and separate action/operation events. Seven duty-day history; automatic midnight resets only checks, clean surface persists. Refresh resets the session; no cross-session storage.
lighthouseOperation.interaction: Native Chinese dialog with explicit local confirmation; 30 continuous active seconds of clear nearby top-floor optic sight, actual phase travel >=1 turn and forward output; 1.5 active second wipe requires previously observed dirt, grounded same-floor access and continued clear aim. Any UI/blur, departure/climbing or running mode cancels. Standby is revalidated at commit; cleaning requires a separate recheck. First-floor control and clipboard, fixed top-floor cover and test control use the original 1.5m nearest-ray gate and independent pause ownership.
lighthouseOperation.protectiveSurface: Original fixed southern curved pane at radius 0.438m, +/-50.4 degrees, height 0.78m, centre gallery+1.21m; 34 vertices. Deterministic GLSL grain/streak salt film, one transparent material; initial film stays until a complete validated wipe. Reused box builder makes a 24-vertex cloth with one original solid fibre material, moving only during the action and excluded from picking/cached shadows. No downloaded texture or randomness.

lighthouseInteriorCurrent.scope: Replaces the historical five-storey layout with service floor and lantern/gallery only. Original three facade windows remain for daylight. Wider shaft, coordinated lantern/gallery/roof, entry threshold/steps and relocated ladder/cabinets share collision data. Total height and beacon optics unchanged. House entry and lighthouse doors close after ten accepted active seconds fully open, retaining swept-body protection. The lighthouse leaf now swings inward to clear a normal one-metre exterior approach; house swing remains unchanged. No extra download, light, shadow target, camera or dependency.
lighthouseInteriorCurrent.cabinetCleanup: 2026-10-21: Removed four orphaned decorative boxes left at the previous cabinet coordinates: cabinet seam, two handles and charger accent. The shared cabinet/controller solids, labels, collision, interaction and lighting remain. No new asset or dependency.
lighthouseInteriorCurrent.controlPanelAccess: 2026-10-23: Moved the service-floor operation panel and its three controls from above the west cabinet to the clear entrance-side wall. Shared LIGHTHOUSE.controlPanel local centre (2.4,-1.8)m, radial angle -atan2(3,4), centre 1.5m above floor, face 0.84m wide by 0.74m high, depth 0.14m. Face points toward the tower centre, away from the ladder boarding bay. Original lighthouse-control-panel ID, real-surface picking, 1.5m range and occlusion checks retained. Reuses original ISC procedural geometry, materials and batches; no new download, light or dependency.

backgroundLandscape.support: Exact existing terrain triangles; hill edges buried 0.18m; roots buried 0.22m into the highest terrain/hill triangle. Entire batch footprints remain outside the walking boundary with a minimum 3m buffer.
backgroundLandscape.rendering: Opaque static shared geometry, per-group bounds, one unclipped PBR material reusing existing exterior HDR/day-night response; existing far-ground material for hills. backgroundLandscape.scope: Original procedural geometry. AI concept art is not shipped. Coast, sea, lighting, paths and movement remain unchanged. Counts are structural costs, not measured FPS or loading benefits.

phaseTwo.scope: Original ISC static geometry; reuses phase-one foliage and existing far-rock PBR. Complete batch bounds outside the walking polygon with at least 3m clearance. Terrain, routes, interaction and phase-one geometry unchanged.

phaseThree.scope: Limited static detail appended to existing batches. Original phase-one and phase-two geometry prefixes, tree positions, hills and walking boundaries retained. No new downloads, textures, lights, render targets, shadows, dependencies or per-frame callbacks.
